data.Name: Questionable Cuisine
data.Description: A wild-eyed NPC blocks your path, waving a ladle dripping with something that might once have been food. 'Try my mystery stew!' they insist. 'Secret family recipe! The secret is I found most of it on the ground!'
data.Outcomes: [{"probability": 0.40, "type": "player_choice", "text": "The NPC thrusts a steaming bowl toward you. The stew is an alarming shade of purple and appears to be moving slightly.", "params": {"choices": [{"name": "Eat the Mystery Stew", "risk": 0.5, "success": {"type": "heal_player", "amount": 15, "text": "Against all odds, it's delicious! You feel rejuvenated and question everything you know about cuisine."}, "failure": {"type": "damage_player", "damage": 10, "text": "Your stomach stages an immediate and violent protest. Was that a shoe in there?"}}, {"name": "Politely Decline", "risk": 0.0, "effect": {"type": "none", "text": "Your stomach thanks you. Your taste buds file a formal complaint about missed opportunities."}}]}}, {"probability": 0.30, "type": "none", "text": "The cook wanders off muttering about ungrateful adventurers and how nobody appreciates experimental gastronomy anymore.", "params": {}}, {"probability": 0.30, "type": "none", "text": "The stew achieves sentience and walks away on its own. The cook chases after it yelling 'Not again!'", "params": {}}]
